translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Juan
book.title: Juan Gwenadganse Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Juan

content: Bab Dummad Burba Nued, degi, Cristogi-gwisgued-burba

Gwenadgan na sabemalad, dulemar Bab-Dummad-Burbagi-sunmakdiiye-sogmalad mer bela be abingamalo, bina be dakmargweloed, we-burba Bab-Dummad-Burba-dibe, ar ade we-napneggi nodmalad, bukidar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged-sunnadsurmalad.
Wegi be wilubdakmaloed, we Bab-Dummad-Burba-dibe: Ar dule-wargwen Jesucristo sanale we-napnegse noniye sogele, we-dule Bab-Dummad-Burbaba sunmakdiido.

Ar dule, Jesucristo sanale we-napnegse nonisurye sogele, a-dule Bab-Dummad-Burbaba sunmakdisurdo. We-burbadi Cristogi-gwisguedid, ar bato bemar itosad, we-degiid-burba danikoye. Ar emigindi a-burba bato we-napneggi gudiid.
Mimmigan, bemar Bab Dummadgad gumalad, bemar we-gakansamaladgi nakwismalad, ar Bab-Dummad-Burba-bemargi-maid bur we-napneggined-burbaba bur dummad.
Ar amardi we-napnegginedsoggu, we-napneggined-igargi sunmakmarsunnad. Degisoggu, we-napnegginmalad a-sunmakmalad itomarsundo.

Anmardi Bab-Dummadgad-gumalad. Ar dule Bab-Dummad-mag-dakele, anmar-ibmar-soged itosundo. Ar dule Bab Dummadgadsulirdi, adi anmar-itosursundo. Ar wegi anmar wissundo, igid burba-napiragwadi, degine, igid burba-napiragwadsuli.
Bab Dummad bela dulemar-sabed

Gwenadgan-sabemalad, na muchub-muchub na sabgumarsun, ar ade sabgued Bab Dummadgi danikid. Belagwapa dulemar-sabgumalad, we-a-dulemar Bab Dummadgi burbar gwalulesmaladid, degisoggu, mag Bab-Dummad-daksundo.
Ar dule sabgusulile, amba Bab-Dummad-aku-dakdo, ar ade Bab Dummad bela-bela dulemar-sabgued.
Bab Dummad dulemar-sabguedi weyob anmarse oyolenonikid, deun E-Machi-wargwennaa-gued we-napnegse anmarga barmiargu, adi e-machigi anmar dula gudiguegar.
We-sabgued-napiragwad weyobid: Ar anmar Bab-Dummad-sabgussulid, Bab Dummad, E anmar-sabgusad, degine, E-Machi-barmiar-gusad, adi anmar-iskued-nabogegar.
Gwenadgan-na-sabemalad, ar Bab Dummad weyob anmar-sabgusate, degisoggu, anmar na muchub-muchub na sabgue-wilubmarmodo.
Ar dule bipisaale Bab-Dummad-gwen-dakdisulid. Ar anmar na muchub-muchub na sabgumalale, Bab Dummad anmargi maido, degine, E-sabgued bur-bule anmargi nasgumaisundo.
Ar Bab Dummad E-Burba-Nued-anmarga-uksadba anmar wissundo, anmar Bab-Dummadgi-akanaid, degine, Bab Dummad anmargi maimogad.
Ar anmar-sunnad an daksamalad, degisoggu, anmar sogsundo, Bab na E-Machi, we-napneg-Abonoged, a na we-napnegse barmiarye.
Ar bela dulemar sogmalad, we-Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Machiye, Bab Dummad we-a-dulemargi maido, degine, we-dulemar Bab Dummadgi akanaimodo.

Anmar wismalad, Bab Dummad anmar-sabed, degine, anmar gwen bensurmarbalid Bab Dummad anmar-sabed. Bab Dummad bela-bela dulemar-sabed. Ar dule dulemar-sabele, we-dule Bab Dummadgi akanaid, degine, Bab Dummad we-a-dulegi maimogad.
Ar anmar napiragwad dulemar-sabguegala, weyob dulemar-sabguer-gebed, adi Bab Dummad igar-naboged-ibagi dobsuli an itomalagar, ar ade anmar we-napneggi Cristo sabguedyobi nanadimogad.
Ar dule sabele, dobee nanasulid, ar ade sabgued dobed-osulo-daed, ar ade dobed, gusgu san-odurdaked sedaniguad. Degisoggu, ar dule dobele, amba yo nue-napiragwad sabgusundo.
Anmar Bab-Dummad-sabed, ar ade Bab Dummad e-inse anmar-sabgusad.
Ar dule-wargwen sog-dibe, Bab Dummad an sabye, degite e-gwenad sae-dakele, we-dule binsa gakansadido. Ar dule e-gwenad-dakdiid sabsulile, ¿igi Bab-Dummad-sabguosunna, ar adi-daksulid? Ar geg sabgue.
Ar anmarga Bab Dummad weyob igar-uksad: Dule Bab-Dummad-sabele, e-gwenad-sabgubaloye.
